fields.materials: Application Materials " * " means necessary documents that you must provide in your application. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents in time. * 1. University Application Form -Download the application form, fill it out on your computer, and submit it in Word format (.doc). -Complete all fields as fully and accurately as possible. Do not leave any blanks — write “None” if a section does not apply. -The form must be filled in English or Chinese. -The form must be handwritten or digitally signed. You can download a template or sample from here . * 2. Passport-sized photo A 2 inches photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Photocopy of valid passport With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included * 4. Highest Degree Graduation Certificate -A formal graduation certificate of your highest completed education level (e.g., Senior High School, Bachelor’s, or Master’s degree). -If the document is not in Chinese or English, it must be translated into Chinese or English and notarized by an authorized translation agency or relevant authority. Self-translations are not accepted. * 5. Highest Degree Academic Transcripts -Formal academic transcripts of your highest completed education level (e.g., Senior High School, Bachelor’s, or Master’s degree), covering ALL academic years, NOT just the final year. -If the document is not in Chinese or English, it must be translated into Chinese or English and notarized by an authorized translation agency or relevant authority. Self-translations are not accepted. * 6. Non-criminal record (Valid within six months) -Please note that this document is generally valid for only 6 months. For instance, if you submit your application in March, your non-criminal record must have been issued no earlier than September of the previous year. -Obtain this certificate from the local police station of your current residence, confirming that you have had no criminal record during the 6 months prior to the date of issuance. -If you are currently in China, the certificate must be issued by the local Chinese police. -If the document is not in Chinese or English, it must be translated and notarized by an authorized agency or relevant authority. Self-translations are not accepted. * 7. Physical examination letter(Valid within six months) -Download the form template, print it, and bring it to a hospital for the required medical tests. The hospital will complete the form with your results. -The medical examination must cover all items listed on the form. -Ensure your photo is attached and the form is stamped and signed by the hospital after the examination. -The medical results are valid for 6 months only. -Forms that are incomplete, lack a final physician’s recommendation, missing the attending physician’s signature, official hospital stamp, or applicant’s sealed photo will be considered invalid. -The document must be in English or Chinese. You can download a template or sample from here . * 8. Bank Statement -An official bank statement, issued and stamped by the bank, showing your parents' or your account balance and ability to support your studies in China. -The account holder must be your financial guarantor, such as a parent. -The balance should cover at least one year’s tuition, accommodation, and living expenses. -Submit a scanned copy or a clear photo (a printed version with bank stamp is preferred). -Please also provide a copy of the financial guarantor’s passport or national ID card. -The document must be in English or Chinese. * 9. Digital Signature -Please sign your name on a white sheet of paper and send us a scanned copy. -This will be used solely for digitally signing relevant application documents on your behalf. * 10. Declaration of No Drugs -Download the specific template required by the university from CUCAS. -Print it, sign it and upload signed and scanned digital copy. -The document must be in English or Chinese. You can download a template or sample from here . Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.
fields.requirements: Entry Requirements 1. High school graduate. 2. 17-55 years old. 3. Never learn degree programs or Chinese language programs longer than 1 year in China before.
